summary: Frontend-only test (390x844) of the role-chooser modal, new bottom tabs, passenger home redesign, driver home headers, Change Role sheet, plus regression checks. Everything requested passed. 1) Fresh email registration (2 TEST users): the role-chooser modal appears over a dim scrim that also covers the tab bar. It has mode-passenger 'I am a Passenger' and mode-driver 'I am a Driver' cards, and both images load (1024px) and float (the translateY changes over time). Picking Driver gave the driver tabs; picking Passenger gave the passenger tabs. The modal closes after a pick and does not come back after reload. Demo passenger, demo driver and the approved TEST driver never saw it. 2) Passenger tabs appear in this order: tab-home, tab-bookings, tab-offer 'Offer Ride' (normal icon), tab-messages, tab-notifications. There is no tab-account. 3) Passenger Home has no wordmark or bell. home-profile-section shows initials and 'Hi, <first name>' and opens /profile. The labels are 'Leaving from', 'Going to', 'Date (any date if empty)' and 'Find a Ride'. An empty submit shows home-form-error. Bengaluru→Mysuru goes to /search. The rent and book cards go to /hire?service=rent and /hire?service=book. 'Recent Searches' with its empty state shows. 4) Driver tabs: home, trips, earnings, messages, notifications. The notifications badge shows 2 for an approved driver with a hire request. driver-home-profile (unregistered driver) and dash-header (approved driver) both open /profile. dash-mode-pill is present. 5) Profile row 'Change Role' opens a sheet titled 'Change Role' with Passenger and Driver options. The 'Change Role' button is disabled until a different role is picked. Switching to Driver and back gave the toasts 'You're now a Driver' and 'You're now a Passenger'. 6) Regression: /find, the Offer Ride tab (verification gate for an unverified user), the Notifications tab and admin login (lands on /admin/dashboard) all work.

issues: Shows only the first word of the name, so 'TEST Role Chooser' shows as 'Hi, TEST' (as intended; noted only for awareness)
The subtitle under the name says 'New driver' for a passenger-mode user (left over from iteration 31)

action_items: Optional cleanup: PassengerHome (app/(tabs)/index.tsx) still keeps the `unread` state, calls /notifications on every focus, and has the `icon` helper with the dot. The bell was removed, so the unread state and the /notifications call are no longer needed.

Optional: RoleChooser's <Modal> has no onRequestClose. On Android, the hardware back button then does nothing and React Native logs a warning. Add onRequestClose={() => {}} (which keeps the modal open on purpose).
critical_code_review_comments: RoleChooser is shown when user.mode_chosen === false. The backend sets mode_chosen=false only for email registrations without account_type. OTP registration passes account_type, so the modal is skipped there (consistent with the in-form choice).
PassengerHome has dead code: unread state, the /notifications fetch and the icon() helper (no longer used except for the admin shield).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 UI-registered TEST users (test_rolechooser_*), plus the iteration-29 setup users (drv, pax, fresh) and one hire request. All were deleted: ui_cleanup_iter32.py <emails> and ui_setup_iter29.py cleanup. Demo modes checked: driver@ = driver, passenger@ = passenger.
